content: नियोगः .²1 Employment, use, application. .²2 An injunction, order, command, direction, commission, charge, appointed task or duty, any business committed to oneʼs care; यः सावज्ञो माधवश्रीनियोगे <ls>M. 5. 8</ls>; मनो नियोगक्रिययोत्सुकं मे <ls>R. 5. 11</ls>; अथवा नियोगः खल्वीदृशो मन्दभाग्यस्य <ls>U. 1</ls>; आज्ञापयतु को नियोगोऽनुष्ठीयतामिति <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; त्वमपि स्वनियोगमशून्यं कुरु ‘go about your own business’, ‘do your appointed duty’, (frequently occurring in plays, and used as a courteous way of asking servants to withdraw). .²3 Fastening or attaching to. .²4 Necessity, obligation; तत् सिषेवे नियोगेन स विकल्पपराङ्मुखः <ls>R. 17. 49</ls>. .²5 Effort, exertion. .²6 Certainty, ascertainment. .²7 An invariable rule; न चैष नियोगो वृत्तिपक्षे नित्यः; समास इति <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 6. 5</ls>. .²8 Commission, act; न कर्ता कस्यचित् कश्चिन्नियोगेनापि चेश्वरः <ls>Rām. 4. 25. 5</ls>. .²9 Right (अधिकार); अलघुनि बहु मेनिरे च ताः स्वं कुलिशभृता विहितं पदे नियोगम् <ls>Ki. 10. 16</ls>. .²10 A practice prevalent in ancient times which permitted a childless widow to have intercourse with the brother or any near kinsman of her deceased husband to raise up issue to him, the son so born being called क्षेत्रज; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 9. 59</ls>:-- देवराद्वा सपिण्डाद्वा स्त्रिया सम्यङ् नियुक्तया . प्रजेप्सिताधिगन्तव्या सन्तानस्य परिक्षये ..; see <ls n="Ms. 9.">60, 65</ls> also. (Vyāsa begot पाण्डु and धृतराष्ट्र on the widows of विचित्रवीर्य in this way).
